model_annotation: The bar chart, labeled Figure 1, illustrates the calendar-based indices of produced pharmaceutical products and projects in Bulgaria from 2022 to 2024, with the data normalized to a base value of 100 for the year 2021. The horizontal axis represents the months of the year, listed in chronological order from I to XII, while the vertical axis displays the index values ranging from 0,000 to 140,000, with intervals of 20,000. Each month is represented by three bars corresponding to the years 2022, 2023, and 2024, colored blue, orange, and grey, respectively. The chart shows that the index values for each month vary across the three years, with some months exhibiting higher or lower values than others; for example, the index value for December 2024 is notably higher than the preceding months, reaching approximately 120,000. The bars are grouped by month, allowing for a comparison of the index values across the three years for each specific month.
